t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice given to me on the previous page advised me to pay close attention to the gnomes and the pairs they always come in as they can lead you to different forests such as a bright one and a dark one and this can depend on the bright ones such as orange/yellow taking you to the dark forest. the goal is to find the forest with the most mushrooms and that this can change in each forest so to keep track of the forest and how many mushrooms I can get.and to focus on more when it comes to x1 vs x5 when it comes to getting more mushrooms and the success relies on remembering the gnomes which take you to which forest and with focus i should be able to figure this out.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, Here I will be detailing some advice on information about this game that you're about to play and tips that I hope will help you.When playing the game the gnomes are often paired up such as orange/brown, pink/green, red/yellow and blue/purple and some will lead  you into the dark forest whilst others will take you into the light forest. The aim is to collect as many mushrooms as this can change depending on the forest you end up in which you should focus on when it comes to the x5 round.Good luck with the game! I'm sure you'll do great best of luck
